_about: Public-domain John Ireland (1838-1918), Archbishop of St. Paul and leader of the Americanist Catholics, for the Word Hoard: The Church and Modern Society, his lectures and addresses (Chicago: McBride, 1896, and the two-volume St. Paul edition of 1905), and his address Patriotism: Its Duty and Value (1894), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 35 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

jireland-church-modern-society-1896: The Church and Modern Society: Lectures and Addresses (Chicago and New York: D. H. McBride; title page undated, copyright 1896)
jireland-church-modern-society-1: The Church and Modern Society: Lectures and Addresses, vol. I (St. Paul: Pioneer Press, 1905)
jireland-church-modern-society-2: The Church and Modern Society: Lectures and Addresses, vol. II (St. Paul: Pioneer Press, 1905)
jireland-patriotism: Patriotism: Its Duty and Value, an address before the New York Commandery of the Loyal Legion, April 4, 1894 (New York: Catholic Book Exchange; title page undated)

_alternates.jireland-copies: Other 1896 and 1903 McBride issues; a 1904 Pioneer Press vol. II (catalogued 1903 in error); his Memoir of Rev. Lucian Galtier and the Shields address (offprints, no imprint)

jireland-patriotism.ia_possible_copyright_status: The Library of Congress is unaware of any copyright restrictions for this item.
